title: SphMind: Towards Robust, Training-Free VLM-based Spatial Reasoning with a 360 Camera
reasons: 材料表明提出方法并使用已有基准评估，未见新基准贡献

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Experiments on three benchmarks show that SphMind achieves over 21.4% average improvement in directional reasoning on MP3D and Stanford2D-3D, outperforms prompt-engineering baselines by 8.7% on the real-world ODI-Bench, and improves rotational invariance by 5.9% under panorama rotations, without additional training or dataset-specific tuning.
